data_fields.name: cursed_unequip_block
data_fields.donor_constant: refused while cursed unless MagicImmune buff

best_idea: Admit a stackable into an existing matching stack before asking for a free slot, so a full pack still takes a matching pickup, and refuse with no change to either container.
decision_why: Take the order of checks (stack first, then a slot, refuse with no change), not the code: the donor is single-player with no max stack, no weight and no bank, so Frankendom must make the rule one server transaction with a catalogue max stack.
acceptance: A server test: a 20-slot bag full of non-matching items accepts a pickup that matches an existing stack (slot count stays 20, quantities add up); it refuses a new kind with both containers unchanged (no duplicate, no loss); and a failed move leaves the source as it was, in the same transaction.
